query:
SELECT c.id as cardId, c.snkrdunkId, COUNT(*) as total_records,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(ph.soldAt) = '2026-03-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as march30_records
FROM cards c
JOIN priceHistory ph ON ph.cardId = c.id
WHERE c.snkrdunkId = '730942'
GROUP BY c.id, c.snkrdunkId;
